requested_by.description: The user's email from session context

attack_path_status.description: e.g. 'unavailable (APA filters ignored by the Tenable MCP this run)' or 'on 3 critical paths'

kev_total.description: Total KEV host/plugin pairs in the briefing forecast (render.py KEV_TOTAL)

plugins.description: Keyed by plugin ID string. One entry per plugin referenced by any host.

cves.description: Lines after 'CVEs: ' — first CVE line, then continuation lines

groups.description: Ticket groups in briefing rank order; used for the header count line and the inline-sample choice

rank.description: Briefing rank of this action (1 = top)

hosts.description: One ticket per host. Do not pre-sort; tickets.py orders by group rank, domain controllers first, then AES desc, then name.

role_inferred.description: true when the role is guessed from the hostname

is_dc.description: Domain controller: sorted first in its group and should use rollback 'dc'

aes.description: null if not in Tenable One

summary.description: Lines, ≤ 100 chars each (keep paths and registry keys on one line)

plugins.description: Plugin IDs in the order to list them; VERIFICATION is generated from these

change.description: Lines; verbatim Tenable Solution text with exact KBs, versions and paths

interim.description: Lines; first line '(Own note, not Tenable text...)' unless quoting Tenable

rollback.description: 'dc' or 'server' for the standard text, or custom lines

risk.description: Lines; tie to kill chain, briefing rank/score and forecast share

notes.description: Lines appended to SUMMARY; the first is prefixed 'Note: ', the rest are indented to match

not_covered.description: Markdown lines for the header's 'Not covered' paragraph; omit if nothing was missed
